request.raw_text: Reduce overall height of Nozzle Volcano part by 1mm, reduction should be made in threaded area.

aim.primary_aim: Produce a Nozzle Volcano part whose overall height is 1 mm less than the original, with the reduction confined to its threaded area.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: threaded area of the Nozzle Volcano part

required_relationships.reference: threaded area of the Nozzle Volcano part

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: geometry of the Nozzle Volcano part outside the threaded area
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve non-targeted geometry under a minimum-change rule.

geometry.description: The threaded area is reduced so that the overall height of the Nozzle Volcano part is 1 mm less than its original overall height.

relationships.reference: threaded area of the Nozzle Volcano part

validation_criteria.description: The final overall height is reduced by exactly 1 mm relative to the original model.
The overall-height reduction is confined to the threaded area.
Geometry outside the threaded area remains unchanged except for any unavoidable boundary continuity associated with the requested final state.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not uniquely identify which threaded area is targeted if the Nozzle Volcano part contains multiple threaded areas.
candidate_interpretations: The threaded area that contributes to the part's overall height
Another threaded area present on the part

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not state which axial end or boundary of the threaded area should define the shortened final extent.
candidate_interpretations: The terminal end of the threaded area that determines overall height
The opposite boundary of the threaded area
